stories.title: Belgrado, il presidente Aleksandar Vucic si dimette per correre alle elezioni anticipate

en.title: Belgrade, President Aleksandar Vucic resigns to run in early elections
en.summary: Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic announced his resignation in a public speech, paving the way for early elections including a presidential race. Vucic aims to become prime minister since constitutional limits prevent him from seeking a third presidential term.

stories.title: Follia a un distributore di Reggio Emilia: tre feriti gravi, arrestato un 26enne

en.title: Violence at a gas station in Reggio Emilia: three seriously injured, 26-year-old arrested
en.summary: A 26-year-old man was arrested after attacking a 57-year-old woman with a screwdriver at a gas station, then driving a car into two other people. Three victims were hospitalized with serious injuries.

stories.title: Aggredisce donna e investe due persone a Reggio Emilia, arrestato

en.title: Assaults woman and hits two people in Reggio Emilia, arrested
en.summary: A violent incident occurred at a petrol station in the evening, resulting in three people being hospitalized with serious injuries. A man was arrested in connection with the attack.

stories.title: Reggio Emilia, a un distributore aggredisce una donna e investe due passanti: tre feriti gravi

en.title: Reggio Emilia, at a gas station attacks woman and hits two passersby: three seriously injured
en.summary: A 26-year-old was arrested after striking a woman with a screwdriver at a gas station and then driving his car toward people attempting to help her. Three victims sustained serious injuries and a home search was underway.

stories.title: Serbia, il presidente Vucic si dimette per candidarsi alla carica di primo ministro

en.title: Serbia, president Vucic resigns to run for prime minister
en.summary: Serbian President Vucic is stepping down because constitutional term limits prevent him from seeking a third presidential term. He will run for prime minister with his right-wing party in early elections on October 25.

stories.title: Reggio Emilia, aggredisce una donna e investe due persone: arrestato

en.title: Reggio Emilia, man attacks woman and hits two people: arrested
en.summary: A man was arrested after assaulting a woman and striking two other people at a gas station in Reggio Emilia, leaving three people seriously injured.

stories.title: Picchiata, torturata e quasi annegata, arrestato 38enne

en.title: Beaten, tortured and nearly drowned, 38-year-old arrested
en.summary: A 38-year-old man was arrested in Pescia after attacking a woman during an evening walk, subjecting her to severe violence before a passerby intervened.

stories.title: Pistoia, rifiuta un approccio sessuale: torturata e quasi annegata, arrestato 38enne

en.title: Pistoia, woman rejects sexual advances: tortured and nearly drowned, 38-year-old arrested
en.summary: A 20-year-old woman was arrested after rejecting unwanted sexual contact from a man who beat her with a belt, struck her with stones, and burned her face with cigarettes. A passerby's alert led to her rescue.

stories.title: Pistoia: rifiuta approccio sessuale, torturata e quasi annegata nel fiume. Arrestato uomo di 38 anni

en.title: Pistoia: rejects sexual advance, tortured and nearly drowned in river. 38-year-old man arrested
en.summary: A woman was assaulted after firmly rejecting sexual advances from a man. The situation escalated leading to her torture and near-drowning before the suspect's arrest.

stories.title: Coppa America a Napoli: trionfa Luna Rossa, New Zealand deve arrendersi

en.title: America's Cup in Naples: Luna Rossa triumphs, New Zealand must surrender
en.summary: Luna Rossa secured victory in the America's Cup race in Naples, with the Italian crew finishing 17 seconds ahead of New Zealand's team.

stories.title: Pistoia, rifiuta le avances e viene torturata e quasi annegata in un fiume: arrestato un 38enne

en.title: Pistoia, woman rejects advances and is tortured and nearly drowned in a river: 38-year-old arrested
en.summary: A 38-year-old man was arrested after allegedly torturing a young woman who rejected his advances, including beating, striking with stones, and burning her face with cigarettes, before a bystander raised the alarm.

stories.title: Il Papa riceve le vittime degli abusi dei preti: “Piaga dolorosa, il mio impegno che non si ripeta”

en.title: Pope receives victims of priest abuse: "Painful scourge, my commitment that it not happen again"
en.summary: The Pope met with seven abuse survivors of various ages in Lourdes and called for continued vigilance among French bishops. He also reiterated his position that ending life cannot be considered normal and no law can deny human dignity.

stories.title: Benzina e diesel, anche Ip fisserà limiti ai prezzi

en.title: Petrol and diesel, Ip will also set price limits
en.summary: Socar is following Eni's example by implementing price caps on petrol and diesel across its Ip distribution network.

en.title: Work-life balance, certification underway
en.summary: A new certification process for companies implementing work-life balance policies under the Uni/Pdr 192:2026 standard is being launched.

stories.title: Halloween, è iniziato il conto alla rovescia per la notte dei fantasmi

en.title: Halloween, the countdown has begun for the night of ghosts
en.summary: Halloween-themed attractions featuring zombies, ghosts, skeletons, vampires, witches, monsters and pumpkins are populating theme parks during October as the All Saints' Day tradition gains prominence.

stories.title: «Regate in mezzo al publico come mai, Luna Rossa e New Zealand i team favoriti»

en.title: Races in the middle of the public like never before, Luna Rossa and New Zealand the favorite teams
en.summary: Francesco de Angelis describes the atmosphere in Naples and sailing conditions for preliminary races, with Luna Rossa and New Zealand positioned as competition favorites.

stories.title: Consolato americano a Milano, la società americana risarcisce i lavoratori con 30 milioni

en.title: American Consulate in Milan, American company compensates workers with 30 million
en.summary: Following a labor exploitation investigation by prosecutors, Caddell has reached a settlement agreement with a court-appointed administrator regarding worker compensation.
